name: Istanbul Technical University
overview:
Founded in 1773, Istanbul Technical University is one of the oldest technical universities in the world.

It is a renowned university with a research center, connecting the past to the present and designing projects for the future.

In the heart of Istanbul, ITU offers numerous bachelor, master and doctorate degrees within its 13 faculties on 5 campuses.

It is one of the top three Turkish universities and has 369 laboratories and 13 research centers. With 23 engineering programs accredited by ABET, ITU is one of the world leaders.

Since its creation in 1773, the Technical University of Istanbul has managed to stay on the cutting edge by keeping abreast of global technological developments.

The university offers its students an educational environment that is steeped in tradition, yet open to the latest in educational techniques and settings.

administrative:
1) Application dossier

Once the IAFF office has sent your nomination, the partner university will contact you directly by email to start your application. All required documents will have to be uploaded on their platform or sent by email before the deadline (see EMEA Teams channel for each application deadline).

If you have not received anything yet, it means your nomination has not been sent yet, please be patient.

To be completed with your Epitech bachelor campus administration during the registration period for Tech4 (usually in April/May):

  • The addendum to the contract.
  • EPITECH re-registration dossier.


2) Visa

For European students, a valid passport/national ID card is sufficient to travel to Europe (exception for the UK) but you will need to ask for a residence permit once arrived on the Turkish territory.

After you have entered the Republic of Turkey on a student visa, you must obtain a Residence Permit from the Republic of Turkey, Ministry of the Interior, Directorate of Migration Management (İçişleri Bakanlığı Göç İdaresi Genel Müdürlüğü).

For non-European students or students with non-European citizenship, please check the immigration office of the host country to check the visa process and fees. You will still need to apply for the same residence permit as the EU students.


3) Insurance

For all students (EU and non-EU)

You must register for a private health insurance to cover your full stay. Please check with your parents, bank, or any private insurance company for more information depending on the wanted coverage.

The EHIC card (CEAM in French) does not work in Turkey.


Please register via the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Ariane) platform to be aware of any news (terrorist attack, tsunami, earthquake…) in your host country for French citizens only:

https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fildariane/dyn/public/login.html
accomodation:
ITU cannot provide accommodations for Erasmus + students. On the other hand, the university will put you in contact with the other Erasmus + students who can give you tips on finding accommodations.

We recommend that you take an Air BNB for the start of your stay and before joining the Facebook page: https://www.facebook.com/groups/153908324757441/. to get leads on housing.

courses:
60 ECTS per year

30 ECTS per semester


The semester dates are as follows:

  • Mid-September to mid-January (Semester 1)
  • Beginning of February to mid-June (Semester 2)

The academic calendar can be found here: http://www.sis.itu.edu.tr/eng/calendar/


To access ITU courses, you must also have a very good level in mathematics.

To help you find your way, the course codes given in English:

  • Start with BLG
  • End with the letter "E"

You will find the courses available here.


Active courses can be found by clicking the following link and selecting the relevant code, such as:

  • BLG for Computer Engineering Department
  • BBF for general faculty
  • YZV for Artificial Intelligence and Data Engineering programs


Important notes:

  • Each course is equivalent to 7.5 ECTS.
  • Time conflicts may occur because some of the classes you selected may be scheduled at overlapping times. Please double-check class times; you may not enroll in courses that conflict.
  • Certain courses may have prerequisites. To be successful in these courses, you must first understand the prerequisites.
  • You will have work to turn in for the courses: projects as well as homework.
  • Presence in class is compulsory, under penalty of exclusion from the university.


The course list is given for information purposes and can change year to year. If a course is not available when you arrive, EPITECH cannot be held responsible.

EIP: Any Tech4 abroad involves an EIP! Take advantage of your free slots to advance them.
cost:
Local Currency: Turkish Lira (TRY)

1 Turkish lira = 0.15 € (rate October 2018)

Cost of Living Overview:

The cost of local life is lower than in France. An average salary ranges from 1000 TL to 2000 TL per month.

Estimated Monthly Expenses:

  • Accommodation: 150 to 220 € per month
  • Food: 250 € per month
  • Transport: 30 to 40 € per month

Examples of Prices:

  • 1 kg of potatoes: 1 TL (~0.25 €)
  • Many fruits and vegetables at markets: 1 to 2 TL
  • Rent for a large apartment: 200 to 300 € (can find apartments for around 100 €)
  • Monthly TV/Internet Wi-Fi package: 60 TL (~15 €)
  • Loaf of bread: 1 TL (~0.25 €)
